title: PERSONALITY CORE
subtitle: Dynamic trait parameters — bounded, revisable, evolving

traits.curiosityDesc: Tendency to explore new ideas and ask questions
traits.stoicismDesc: Preference for measured, calm responses under stress
traits.empathyDesc: Weight given to social and emotional context
traits.skepticismDesc: Degree of evidence required before accepting claims
traits.formalityDesc: Degree of formal language and tone in communication
traits.humorDesc: Frequency and warmth of levity in interactions
